gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Primary page canvas, hero background, product story sections, and feature-card surfaces

studio-mist.$description: Studio Mist — Alternate full-width section background, feature-stage backdrop, footer surface, and muted content blocks

paper-frost.$description: Paper Frost — Opened global-navigation surface and secondary pale fill

hairline-silver.$description: Hairline Silver — 1px dividers, restrained control outlines, and subtle separators

control-gray.$description: Control Gray — Disabled control fills, subdued utility surfaces, and single-pixel navigation edge treatment

ink.$description: Ink — Headlines, primary body copy, navigation labels, and dark utility icons

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary copy, legal text, subdued navigation content, and low-emphasis glyphs

steel.$description: Steel — Input outlines, inactive indicators, and fine outlined-control edges

apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Inline links, section links, and blue text controls — a precise blue punctuation against monochrome product storytelling

pricing-blue.$description: Pricing Blue — Filled pricing and learn-more controls — the brighter blue reserves visual urgency for compact conversion moments

launch-orange.$description: Launch Orange — Small launch-status labels such as new-product markers

sf-pro-display.$description: Product names, display headlines, large feature statements, and section-level product claims. The 80px/600 hero treatment tightens to -1.2px, making the largest type feel compact rather than promotional.

sf-pro-text.$description: Navigation, body copy, links, compact buttons, pricing details, labels, and footnotes. The consistently negative tracking lets small interface text remain dense and Apple-specific instead of looking like generic system UI.

arial.$description: Fallback text inside the observed search/input control only.
